title: Sweat, Sculpt & Art After Dark with YogaSix Royal Oak & Black Heart Gallery
description: Y6 Sculpt meets immersive art, complimentary beverages, and live DJ at The Black Heart Art Gallery. Costumes encouraged, limited tickets.
long_description:
Y6 Sculpt meets immersive art, complimentary beverages, and live DJ at The Black Heart Art Gallery. Costumes encouraged, limited tickets.

About this Event

Friday, October 30 | 6:00–8:30 PM
The Black Heart Art Galley | $50 | Limited to 50 guests

A fun & unique Halloween experience combining a 45-minute themed Y6 Sculpt class, immersive art, live DJ Muva Mars, and complimentary drinks at Black Heart’s private gallery space.

Event Flow:
• 6:00 PM: Doors open + DJ
• 6:30–7:15 PM: Halloween themed Y6 Sculpt class
• 7:15–8:30 PM: Private gallery walkthrough + social hour with complimentary drinks
• DJ: Muva Mars, 6:00–7:30 PM
• Costumes encouraged
• Bring your mat

Ticket includes: Y6 Sculpt class, private gallery experience, complimentary beverages, live DJ, and the full Halloween experience.

Only 50 tickets available.
Come for the flow. Stay for the art. Let’s get weird.

Also check out other in Detroit, Arts events in Detroit, Workshops in Detroit.
